037/**
038 * MapFragment is a Fragment subclass responsible for displaying a Google Map and interacting
039 * with map-related elements and user actions. It implements OnMapReadyCallback to manage
040 * GoogleMap initialization and OnItemSelectedListener to handle selection changes in the tracks
041 * dropdown menu. The fragment integrates multiple ViewModels and observes LiveData to synchronize
042 * UI elements with real-time data updates.
043 *
044 * Responsibilities:
045 * - Displays a Google Map using Google Maps SDK.
046 * - Manages lifecycle events of the map to ensure proper behavior during Fragment lifecycle changes.
047 * - Observes and reacts to changes in permissions, location, and pin data via injected ViewModels.
048 * - Displays and updates markers on the map based on observed pin data.
049 * - Handles user interactions such as selecting tracks and creating new pins.
050 *
051 * Integrations:
052 * - PermissionsViewModel: Monitors and updates the user's permissions, specifically location-related permissions.
053 * - LocationViewModel: Provides live updates of the user's current location and manages location services.
054 * - PinViewModel: Stores and updates information about tracks and pins, including handling current selection and displaying pin markers on the map.
055 *
056 * Key Lifecycle Handling:
057 * - Registers observers for LiveData from ViewModels to update UI elements dynamically.
058 * - Manages Google Map lifecycle by forwarding lifecycle callbacks to the map object.
059 *
060 * Implementations:
061 * - OnMapReadyCallback: Enables map setup when the map instance is ready.
062 * - OnItemSelectedListener: Handles user interactions with the track selection dropdown menu.
063 */
064@AndroidEntryPoint
065public class MapFragment extends Fragment implements OnMapReadyCallback, OnItemSelectedListener {
066
067  private PermissionsViewModel permissionsViewModel;
068  private LocationViewModel locationViewModel;
069  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
070  private FragmentMapBinding mapBinding;
071  private boolean currentLocationEnabled;
072  private GoogleMap map;
073  private List<Track> tracks;
074  private CameraUpdate cameraUpdate;
075  private Track track;
076
077  @Nullable
078  @Override
079  public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater,
080      @Nullable ViewGroup container,
081      @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
082    mapBinding = FragmentMapBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
083    mapBinding.mainMap.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
084    mapBinding.mainMap.getMapAsync(this);
085    mapBinding.tracks.setOnItemSelectedListener(this);
086    mapBinding.newPin.setOnClickListener((v) -> Navigation.findNavController(mapBinding.getRoot())
087        .navigate(MapsPinsNavGraphDirections.editPin()));
088    // TODO: 3/31/25 Attach listeners to UI widgets
089    return mapBinding.getRoot();
090  }
091
092  @Override
093  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
094    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
095
096    FragmentActivity activity = requireActivity();
097    ViewModelProvider provider = new ViewModelProvider(activity);
098    LifecycleOwner owner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
099
100    locationViewModel = provider.get(LocationViewModel.class);
101    locationViewModel.getLocation()
102        .observe(owner, location -> {
103           cameraUpdate = CameraUpdateFactory.newLatLng(
104              new LatLng(location.getLatitude(), location.getLongitude()));
105          centerCamera();
106        });
107    getLifecycle().addObserver(locationViewModel);
108    permissionsViewModel = provider.get(PermissionsViewModel.class);
109    permissionsViewModel
110        .getPermissionsStatus()
111        .observe(owner, (permissions) -> {
112          if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(
113              permissions.getOrDefault(permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, false))) {
114            locationViewModel.startService();
115            currentLocationEnabled = true;
116          } else {
117            currentLocationEnabled = false;
118          }
119        });
120    pinViewModel = new ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(PinViewModel.class);
121    pinViewModel
122        .getTracks()
123        .observe(owner, (tracks) -> {
124          this.tracks = tracks;
125          ArrayAdapter<Track> adapter =
126              new ArrayAdapter<>(requireContext(), android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, tracks);
127          mapBinding.tracks.setAdapter(adapter);
128          setSelectedTrack();
129        });
130    pinViewModel.getTrack().observe(owner, (track) -> {
131      this.track = track;
132      setSelectedTrack();
133    });
134    pinViewModel
135        .getPins()
136        .observe(owner, this::handlePins);
137  }
138
139  /**
140   * Sets the currently selected track in the UI to match the position of the {@code track}
141   * field within the {@code tracks} list. If {@code track} or {@code tracks} are {@code null},
142   * this method does nothing.
143   *
144   * The method retrieves the index of the {@code track} within the {@code tracks} list using
145   * the {@code indexOf} method. If the {@code track} exists in the list, the selection of
146   * the UI component represented by {@code mapBinding.tracks} is updated to the matching
147   * position.
148   */
149  private void setSelectedTrack() {
150    if (track != null && tracks != null) {
151      int position = tracks.indexOf(track);
152      mapBinding.tracks.setSelection(position);
153    }
154  }
155
156  /**
157   * Adjusts the camera of the map to a specified update if both the map and
158   * camera update objects are not null.
159   *
160   * This method ensures the camera's position is updated smoothly by invoking
161   * the moveCamera method on the map instance with the specified camera update.
162   * If either the map or the camera update is null, the method does nothing.
163   */
164  private void centerCamera() {
165    if (map != null && cameraUpdate != null) {
166      map.moveCamera(cameraUpdate);
167    }
168  }
169
170  /**
171   * Processes a list of pins to populate a map with markers based on each pin's location.
172   * The map is cleared initially, and for each pin in the list, a marker is created
173   * using the title and location from the pin and added to the map.
174   *
175   * @param pins a list of Pin objects to be processed, each containing a title and location data
176   */
177  private void handlePins(List<Pin> pins) {
178    map.clear();
179    pins.forEach((pin) -> {
180      Location location = pin.getLocation();
181      if (location != null) {
182        MarkerOptions options = new MarkerOptions()
183            .title(pin.getTitle())
184            .position(new LatLng(location.latitude(), location.longitude()));
185        map.addMarker(options);
186      }
187    });
188    // DONE 4/1/25 Iterate over pins, create marker for each, and add it to map (googleMap Map field)
189  }
190

195  }

229    mapBinding.mainMap.onLowMemory();

231  }
232
233  /**
234   * Manipulates the map once available. This callback is triggered when the map is ready to be
235   * used. This is where we can add markers or lines, add listeners or move the camera. In this
236   * case, we just add a marker near Sydney, Australia. If Google Play services is not installed on
237   * the device, the user will be prompted to install it inside the SupportMapFragment. This method
238   * will only be triggered once the user has installed Google Play services and returned to the
239   * app.
240   */
241
242  @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
243  @Override
244  public void onMapReady(GoogleMap googleMap) {
245    map = googleMap;
246    if (currentLocationEnabled) {
247      googleMap.setMyLocationEnabled(true);
248      centerCamera();
249    }
250  }
251
252  @Override
253  public void onItemSelected(AdapterView<?> adapterView, View view, int position,
254      long generatedId) {
255    pinViewModel.setTrack((Track) adapterView.getItemAtPosition(position));
256  }
257
258  @Override
259  public void onNothingSelected(AdapterView<?> adapterView) {
260//No action needed, this doesn't happen
261  }
262}
